changeinfo.changes: - Fixed issue causing Story Mode and Arcade Mode panels to not appear. - Fixed bug preventing the trophy being unlocked for completing Wolf Level 6. - Adjusted various obstacles to streamline gameplay. - Improved final fight sequence. - Dialogue now defaults to output through TV. Dialogue can be set to play through the controller via the options menu. - Story Mode panel now displays information on which levels have been completed with no deaths. - Various smaller bugfixes and improvements.
